page.overview:
Who is Fordyce?

Fordyce was a fictional operative of "MI5" and tailor assigned to their Agents' Outfitting department. Portrayed by the British actor John Wells, the character appeared in the 1967 parody spy film, Casino Royale.

Fordyce was a tailor who oversaw the Agents' Outfitting department of the "James Bond 007 Training School", ostensibly located in the basement of the Harrods department store in Knightsbridge, London. He is slightly catty and haughty and moonlights as a Harrods' employee. Somewhat haughty and effete, he is heavily implied to be homosexual. On the morning of the 14th March, he and his superior Q outfitted prospective spy Evelyn Tremble with an American-designed two-way television and radio wristwatch, and "protective clothing".
